title: Quantization behind an accuracy gate
design_ref: Quantization: smaller weights and KV cache are adopted only if an accuracy gate passes
purpose: Serve the same model as fp16, with int4 weights (AWQ), with an int8 KV cache, and with both; ask 400 questions with exact answers of each; apply a written gate (at most 3 points lost, at least 90% identical answers); and only then read whether the gated configurations serve more.

steps.output:
config     weights GiB   KV tokens   capacity req/s   goodput tok/s   gate
fp16           7.56      31,776         0.44         43.1   reference
awq            2.50      67,760         0.65         68.5   FAILS
kv8            7.56      61,632         0.42         43.1   passes
awq-kv8        2.50     131,424         0.65         68.5   FAILS

checks.because: The reference is the unquantized model; every gate decision is a comparison with it.

checks.description: the reference scores well above chance and below perfect, so the questions can show damage in either direction
checks.because: fp16 accuracy 87.2%. Few-shot arithmetic with one short answer leaves a 4B model no room to reason, so a numerical change in the weights or cache shows up as a wrong digit.

checks.description: the gate is applied to every quantized configuration that started and each gets a recorded pass or fail
checks.because: The gate (at most 3 points lost and at least 90% identical answers) was written before the numbers were read. Standard error of a 400-question accuracy is about 2 points, which is why the agreement test is part of it.

checks.description: int4 weights free memory for the KV cache: the AWQ server holds more KV tokens than fp16
checks.because: 67,760 against 31,776 tokens; weights 2.5 GiB against 7.56 GiB.

checks.description: an int8 KV cache holds about twice the tokens of fp16 in the same memory (ratio between 1.7 and 2.1)
checks.because: 61,632 against 31,776 tokens: ratio 1.94. One byte per element instead of two, less the scale factors stored per token and head.

notes: Adopted into the tuned stack (gate passed and capacity higher than fp16 by more than one grid step of 0.15 req/s/GPU): none.
FP8 weights and FP8 KV cache are not run: the T4 (compute capability 7.5) has no FP8 units. FP4 needs Blackwell. The gate and the procedure are the same for those formats; only the hardware differs.
